visibility_winner_panel._multi_category_note: Split/Unranked/competitor rows are not guaranteed in every category. Spec searches across Hybrid → SUVs → Electric Cars in order.

winner_column._note: Column 3 (td:nth-child(3)) of each Visibility question row — 4 possible states
winner_column._note_brand: Bold dark-slate span — shown when brand is #1 in all engines (Favorable). Actual class: 'font-medium text-slate-900 text-sm leading-5' — dot-notation still works with extra classes.
winner_column._note_competitor: Lighter span — shown when a competitor is #1 in all engines (brand is Unfavorable or Unranked).
winner_column._note_unranked: Red badge with text 'Unranked' / 'Non classé' (FR). No data-testid — class-based selector required. WRONG: span[data-testid='dashboard-questions-favorability-badge'].border-red-200 (testid absent in Hybrid Cars).
winner_column._note_split: Orange badge with text 'Split' / 'Partagé' (FR). No data-testid — class-based selector required. WRONG: span[data-testid='dashboard-questions-favorability-badge'].border-orange-200 (testid absent).

panel_containers._note_panel: Outer container for all panel content. Confirmed stable data-testid.
panel_containers._note_responses: Section containing per-engine favorability cards. Scope badge assertions here to avoid false positives from page-level elements.

ranking_list._note_item: Each li contains rank number + competitor name as text. First item = #1 competitor. Text format: '1\nTesla Model Y'.

competitive_winner_panel._note: Selectors for e2e-category-question-competitive.spec.js — validated 2026-07-01 on staging
competitive_winner_panel._data_map: Brand winner: Hybrid Cars (all 40 rows). Competitor (Tesla): Electric Cars (8 rows). Lost plain: Electric Cars (31 rows). Split: SUVs (10 rows).

winner_column._note: Column 3 (td:nth-child(3)) of each Competitive question row — 4 possible states. Data-testid NOT present on winner cells.
winner_column._note_brand: Bold dark-slate span — shown when brand won in all active LLM engines.
winner_column._note_competitor: Lighter span (not bold) — shown when a specific competitor won in all active engines. Distinct from brand: no font-medium class.
winner_column._note_lost: Faded grey plain text 'Lost' / 'Perdu' (FR) — no badge border. Brand lost but no single consensus competitor across all engines.
winner_column._note_split: Orange badge with text 'Split' / 'Partagé' (FR) — mixed Won/Lost per engine. No data-testid.

panel_containers._note: Identical data-testids as Visibility panel — shared component.
